ingest_disposition.reason: No new packet is minted or re-consumed. This is a direct exact-donor source correction/refinement of the already admitted Stop-hook forensics under current supervisor 9.13.

source_atoms.finding: The file-level hard boundary says there is no LLM call in a hook, ever, and that hook time budgets are protected by a hard SIGALRM upper bound.

retrieval_episodes already persists replay-relevant identity fields retrieval_id, turn_id, episode_id, causal_id, session_id and generation. The identity substrate therefore exists before model relevance feedback.
_ollama_generate is synchronous and catches a generic Exception after transport-specific exceptions, returning None for every generic exception.

_kognition_richten_hook chooses one unscored row by session_id plus newest ts, reconstructs the query from the latest transcript user message, and only after selection writes feedback through the selected retrieval row. It does not require turn_id, episode_id, causal_id or generation equality at selection time.
_HookTimeout subclasses Exception and the SIGALRM handler raises _HookTimeout.
cmd_hook arms ITIMER_REAL around the hook and expects _HookTimeout to reach the outer timeout handler.

corrected_findings.finding: The prior interpretation that a global SIGALRM during synchronous Stop cognition necessarily transfers to cmd_hook's outer _HookTimeout handler is not supported by the exact donor source. Because _HookTimeout is an Exception and _ollama_generate catches generic Exception, the alarm can be consumed inside the local model call and converted to None. _kognition_richten_hook also has its own generic Exception catch as a second swallowing boundary.
corrected_findings.implication: After delivery, the one-shot timer may no longer provide the intended outer hard-stop behavior for later Stop bookkeeping. This is a source-level control-flow defect/hazard, not runtime proof of an overrun.
corrected_findings.supersedes_claim: Any earlier delta wording that treated SIGALRM escape to the outer handler as guaranteed.

corrected_findings.finding: The Stop relevance identity problem is not absence of retrieval identity columns. Exact retrieval/turn/episode/causal/generation fields are already persisted. The downgrade occurs in _kognition_richten_hook selection and transcript pairing, which select by session/newest instead of binding to those existing fields.
corrected_findings.implication: Target-2.0 should repair the selector/join and fail closed on identity mismatch rather than introduce a second retrieval identity schema.

corrected_findings.finding: The same current donor file both states 'no LLM call in a hook, ever' and later explicitly documents the Stop model judge as a deliberate boundary case. The contradiction is therefore source-visible and intentional-at-implementation level, but unresolved at contract level.

target_2_0_actions.rule: Bind candidate feedback to exact retrieval_id plus turn_id/episode_id/causal_id/generation or an equivalent replay-stable origin envelope. session_id and newest-row ordering are context only, never the causal join key.
Use query/turn evidence bound to the selected retrieval origin. Do not use the globally latest transcript user message as an implicit join under overlapping or reordered Stop processing.

A hard hook timeout exception must not be swallowed by local model fail-silent exception handlers. Separate model-transport failure from global hook-deadline cancellation, or move slow/model-derived work outside the deterministic critical hook path.

required_discriminators: Static/unit test: force the hook deadline while _ollama_generate is active and assert the deadline reaches the outer hook boundary rather than being converted to None.
Two same-session retrieval episodes with distinct turn_id/episode_id/causal_id/generation and reversed/interleaved Stop processing; model relevance must attach only to the intended retrieval_id.
Transcript mismatch test: newest transcript user message differs from the selected retrieval's originating turn; feedback must fail closed rather than score the old retrieval against the new query.
Source/build-bound Stop timing run for cognition disabled, warm local model, slow/cold local model and unreachable local model, without modifying Frank Harness.
counterhypotheses: Normal single-threaded session ordering may make newest-open retrieval and latest-user transcript coincide most of the time; this does not establish correctness under overlap/replay and must be tested.

urllib or another lower layer may often time out at the 1.3s local-model budget before the outer hook alarm fires; that would reduce observed incidence but would not repair the exception-class collision in the hard deadline design.

The intended architecture may deliberately permit local model work in Stop despite the file header; if so, the header/spec must be revised and the model step given an explicit bounded contract rather than carrying both rules simultaneously.
contradictions_preserved: No-hook-LLM hard boundary versus explicit synchronous local Ollama Stop inference.
Hard outer SIGALRM intent versus generic Exception handlers that can consume _HookTimeout.
Rich retrieval causal identity at persistence time versus session/newest identity downgrade at model-feedback selection time.
triggerword4_handoff: Repair existing causal selector identity rather than adding schema; preserve global-deadline cancellation as a non-swallowable control signal or defer model work outside the deterministic Stop critical path; then execute the supervisor-required external/source-bound discriminators without changing Frank Harness.
